entities.summary: Pablo Kleinman is an Argentine-born American entrepreneur and talk show host who was involved in the development of online services in Latin America. Until January 6, 2021, he was the host of Radio California Libre, produced by Univision's Los Angeles flagship talk radio KTNQ. He is a co-founder and former Chief Operating Officer at VOZ, a Dallas-based U.S. Hispanic media company.
